title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Persistent

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026.

About Position

We are hiring a Product Owner with strong Lending (LOS) domain expertise to drive product vision, prioritize features, and lead Agile delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful solutions, ensuring seamless product execution and enhanced customer experience in a fast-paced fintech environment. Please mention a brief description of the position.

  • Role: Product Owner
  • Location: Any PSL Location
  • Experience: 6 to 10 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do

  • Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
  • Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
  • Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
  • Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
  • Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
  • Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
  • Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business-friendly summaries.
  • Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
  • Ensure understanding of end-to-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented culture with shared accountability.

Expertise You'll Bring

  • Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
  • Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
  • Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross-functional teams.
  • Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced English communication skills (B2+ or higher).
  • Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  • We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
  • Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
  • If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”

Product Owner, Lending Domain, LOS, LMS

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗮𝗹 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗿 – 𝗕𝟮𝗕 𝗙𝗹𝗲𝗲𝘁 𝗗𝗶𝗴𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲𝘀. This is a strategic product leadership role at a major OEM, owning the end-to-end digital experiences that connect fleet operators, drivers, dealers, and vehicles — covering web and mobile apps for vehicle onboarding, operations, diagnostics, and lifecycle management.


𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘀:

  • Location: Bengaluru, India
  • Working model: Hybrid
  • Start date: ASAP
  • Employment type: Full-time, Contract or Freelance


𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:

  • Define a compelling multi-year product strategy and annual roadmaps for fleet management tools and driver-facing applications
  • Maintain a strong pulse on market trends, competitive landscape, and user behavior to inform prioritization
  • Balance long-term platform investments with short-term feature delivery, ensuring scalability and sustainability
  • Collaborate with regional teams to adapt solutions for local market needs, compliance requirements, and partner integrations
  • Partner with engineering and UX to deliver high-quality web and mobile experiences — writing clear requirements, prioritizing backlogs, and defining success metrics
  • Lead cross-functional execution across distributed teams and communicate roadmap, progress, and trade-offs to senior stakeholders
  • Drive alignment across engineering, UX, marketing, commercial teams, and external partners around OKRs, roadmaps, and product vision
  • Use data and customer insights to continuously improve adoption and retention


𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred
  • 10+ years of product management experience with a strong background in B2B and/or platform products
  • Experience in automotive, EVs, logistics, or mobility ecosystems is a strong plus
  • Solid understanding of connected vehicle platforms, telematics, APIs, and mobile, web, and embedded (in-vehicle) architectures
  • Proven ability to define, deliver, and measure end-to-end customer experiences across digital and physical touchpoints
  • Strong grasp of software architecture and connected services, with confidence to make trade-offs and challenge assumptions alongside engineering partners
  • Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum practices including backlog ownership, iteration planning, and cross-functional delivery
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and build consensus


𝗡𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗽𝘀:

  • Press "Apply"
  • We will review your application
  • If qualified, you will be accepted into the network and can be considered for this and similar positions & projects

title: Sr. Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Join Itron as a Product Manager and help shape the future of clean energy. We're looking for a collaborative, systems-minded leader to help evolve our Distributed Intelligence platform, which is a key enabler in building a more sustainable, reliable, and customer-centric electric grid. In this role, you’ll be an active participant in developing software to increase grid resiliency, integrate renewable energy sources, and improve real-time grid operations. The Distributed Intelligence platform serves Itron’s Grid Edge Intelligence applications with a scalable, interoperable, and thoughtfully designed system for managing application deployments and integrating data from multiple sources. As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll define core capabilities for how to deliver software and analytics at the grid edge, and play a key role in unifying platform services across multiple grid management use cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape and manage product requirements for Itron’s Distributed Intelligence Enterprise Application Center, which manages utility software applications running at the grid edge.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including engineering, architecture, and implementation—to deliver solutions that are aligned with technical, operational, and customer needs.
  • Contribute to platform software architecture strategy, and design, including performance, normalization, and support for scalable software services.
  • Define how grid edge data is governed, managed, and distributed, to support utility data analytics and artificial intelligence / AI use cases.
  • Support and troubleshoot customer software deployments and migrations, while creating and maintaining technical documentation and solution guidelines.
  • Engage in product discovery to ensure development is grounded in user needs, market insights, and utility goals

Required Skills And Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical product management, solution architecture, or energy software development
  • Experience and understanding of distributed software systems such as IoT/internet of things, or utility metering.
  • Adept at evangelizing and driving cross-functional consensus across internal groups and external customers.
  • Understanding of data management and database design principles.
  • Exposure to utility operations systems (e.g., AMI, ADMS, GIS, CIS), or similar from a related field.
  • Strong and flexible communication skills, able to communicate with both a technical and sales audience interchangeably.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, energy systems, or related field

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Previous utility industry experience
  • Understanding of cloud-native platforms and microservices architectures
  • Awareness of cybersecurity best practices for energy systems
  • Experience working in Agile environments and using tools like Microsoft ADS, Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps

Master’s degree in technical or energy-related discipline is a plus

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today

At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.

In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.

While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!

You need to be a HODLer of these

  • 4-6+ years of relevant product management experience
  • At least 1 year of experience in building and creating product strategy/roadmap.
  • Strong grasp of user centered design process
  • Well-rounded interpersonal skills, and experience interacting with diverse personalities
  • MBA degree from a tier 1/2 business school
  • Bachelo's degree in technology or engineering from a tier 1,/ school

You will be mining through these tasks

  • Role is at an intersection of Payments/Banking rails and Compliance and will need to work closely with senior product managers of these two squads.
  • Manage the focus area for Fund Sources (Banks, On-Ramp Partners), KYC, AML and overall on-ramp/off-ramp rails.
  • Create a roadmap for the enhancements / addition to the product portfolio based on extensive data crunching and clearly defined KPIs and objectives
  • Responsible for delivering critical projects with crucial timelines and significant business impact.
  • Managing and executing decisions about the high-level technical architecture, product processes / automation and UI/UX designs of the project
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across functions to understand the user problem and their needs and formulate achievable requirements for development teams
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth.
  • Person would be willing to write technical PRD’s and work with engineering team and design team and execute the product roadmap
  • The growth path for this role (APM / PM role) can be into a PM/ SPM in either core Payments or Compliance team, based on performance, need of the org and also choice of the candidate.
  • Candidates should have prior product experience in KYC funnels OR Payment Gateway OR Risk/AML. Working with 3P tools like Signzy/Karza OR banking partners is BIG PLUS.

Are you the one? Our missing block

  • You are knowledge-hungry when it comes to VDA and Web3, always eager to dive deeper and stay ahead in this evolving space.
  • The world of Web3 and VDA excites you, fueling your curiosity and driving you to explore new opportunities within this dynamic landscape.
  • You act like an owner, constantly striving for excellence, impact, and tangible results in everything you do.
  • You embrace a ‘We over Me’ mindset, growing individually while fostering the growth of those around you.
  • Change is your catalyst, igniting your passion to build and innovate.
  • You think outside the box, unbound by limitations or doubt, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Perks That Empower You

Our benefits are designed to make a lasting impact on your life, giving you the freedom to create a work-life balance that truly suits you.﻿﻿

  • Design Your Own Benefit: Tailor your perk package to fit your unique needs. Whether you’re eyeing a new gadget or welcoming a furry friend into your life, our flexible benefits ensure that you can prioritize what matters most to you.
  • Unlimited Wellness Leaves: We believe in the power of well-being. Take the time you need to recharge, knowing that your health is our priority. With unlimited wellness leaves, you can return refreshed, ready to build and grow.
  • Mental Wellness Support: Your mental health is as important as your professional growth. Benefit from access to health experts, free counseling sessions, monthly wellness workshops, and regular team outings, all designed to help you stay balanced and connected.
  • Bi-Weekly Learning Sessions: These sessions are more than just updates—they’re opportunities to fuel your growth. Stay ahead with the latest industry knowledge, sharpen your skills, and accelerate your career in an ever-evolving landscape.

title: Technical Product Owner II
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As a Technical Product Owner II here at Honeywell, you will lead and mentor a team of Technical Product Owners, providing strategic guidance and overseeing the entire product development lifecycle. Collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product managers and engineers, will be a key aspect of your role, ensuring a cohesive approach to product development. Your strategic influence will extend to driving innovation within the product management function, identifying opportunities for technological advancements, and actively participating in strategic decision-making to shape the overall direction of the Technical Product Owner team.

In this role, you will impact Honeywell's position at the forefront of technological advancements by driving efficient and timely product development, contributing to continuous improvement and innovation, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that meet customer needs.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define and prioritize technical requirements
  • Drive the development of technical specifications and ensure alignment with overall product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance to the development team throughout the product lifecycle
  • Work closely with the Technical Product Owner Manager to ensure timely and successful product delivery
  • Actively participate in product planning and roadmap discussions

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 2+ years of experience in a Technical Product Owner management role or similar technical leadership position
  • Mastery understanding of software development methodologies and processes
  • Experience working in agile development environments and familiarity with agile principles
  • Proven track record of successfully managing technical teams

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or another related field.
  • Certifications in product management or agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving capability

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

descriptionHtml:

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial, driven Senior Product Manager to lead the charge on our next-generation AI Insights solutions. In this 0-to-1 role, you will operate with scrappy, startup-minded velocity within the stability and scale of a mid-sized enterprise environment.

You will not just be managing a roadmap; you will be building a product from the ground up that leverages machine learning and AI to deliver actionable, transformative insights to contact center operations. You are comfortable navigating the messiness of real-world data and the limitations of ML models in production, making tough tradeoff calls with incomplete information, and pivoting quickly when things aren't working.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Execution

  • Define and execute the 0-to-1 product strategy for Five9's AI-powered insights and analytics offerings

Navigate Ambiguity

  • Handle real-world data complexities, manage ML model limitations in production environments, and make critical product decisions even when data is incomplete

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner deeply with Engineering, Applied Science/ML, Design, and GTM functions to deliver superior products for our customers

Customer-Centric Iteration

  • Actively engage with customers and design partners to gather feedback, validate assumptions, and refine the product roadmap based on real-world usage and pain points

Market Leadership

  • Conduct competitive research and market analysis to identify new opportunities in AI/ML analytics and maintain a competitive edge

Ruthless Prioritization

  • Demonstrate a builder's instinct with strong opinions, loosely held. Know when to double down and possess a track record of confidently killing features or pivoting strategies that aren't working

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • MBA or Master’s in Data Science, Analytics, or related degrees is a plus

Professional Experience

  • 4+ years of comprehensive professional experience in SaaS Product Management
  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate adaptability and success across both agile, high-growth startup environments and established enterprise organizations

Product Leadership

  • A proven track record in a formal Product Management capacity, successfully delivering B2B SaaS solutions

Industry Expertise (Required)

  • Essential background in the Contact Center or Customer Experience (CX) industry coupled with direct experience building and shipping AI-driven products

Technical Acumen

  • Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle for ML-driven solutions, including data collection, model training tradeoffs, and analytics

Execution-Oriented

  • A highly autonomous operator capable of driving initiatives forward without relying on extensive operational support structures
  • Must be able to articulate and defend strategic decisions effectively and collaboratively

Critical Competencies

Successful candidates for this role will demonstrate:

Applied AI Proficiency

  • Practical experience managing the realities of LLMs and machine learning deployments, including addressing latency constraints, optimization, and accuracy challenges

Operational Excellence

  • A strong bias for action and a proven ability to translate high-level strategy into tangible, delivered products

Client Advocacy

  • A strong commitment to direct customer interaction and a willingness to engage continuously with clients to resolve challenges, gather feedback, and drive product adoption

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

title: Lead/Group Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Noora Health India Private Limited is a key partner in Noora Health’s mission is to improve outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with the skills they need to care for their loved ones. They develop content, technology platforms, new products, and strengthen other operational functions that support the scale and impact of Noora Health’s programs.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 58 million caregivers and patients across 16,300+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

About The Role

The Mobile Care Companion (MCC) is Noora Health's primary digital touchpoint for family caregivers post discharge, serving ~50,000 users a day across India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal. It delivers behavior change and health system navigation at scale through two-way conversations, clinical triage, care coordination, and a growing set of AI-powered features.

This role owns MCC end-to-end: the caregiver experience, the health worker tools, the clinical workflows, and the AI layer that cuts across all of it. You will define what MCC becomes over the next three years, be accountable for both growth and outcomes, and lead an interdisciplinary team spanning product, clinical, data, and program functions to get there.

What You Will Do

  • Overall Model: Own the growth and operating model for MCC across user acquisition, activation, and retention at scale, including how MCC is positioned, priced, and deployed across government health systems and private partners
  • AI-led Product Experience: Reimagine the delivery with an AI-first thinking. Reason through where AI owns, where it assists, and where the experts jump in. Embed AI with an eval-led approach iterating to improve accuracy, engagement, and behavior change.
  • Product Roadmap: Set and execute the product roadmap to improve the user experience across the full funnel. Work with country program teams to translate local context (language, literacy, health system constraints) into product decisions that hold across four countries
  • Management & Execution: Deliver individually while also managing and mentoring a team of PMs, designers, clinicians across geographies.
  • Partnership & Advocacy: Represent the product with key internal and external stakeholders including health system partners, funders, leadership, and country teams to drive buy-in and unlock partnerships to drive MCC’s growth.

Who Are We Looking For

  • A 0-to-1 builder/founder: You have taken at least one product from concept to production to scale in a resource-constrained environment and owned its outcomes. You don't need scaffolding to get started
  • 6–12 years of product experience, with a meaningful share on AI-powered products; Hands-on fluency with LLMs: prompt design, retrieval architectures, eval pipelines, MCPs, and optimization workflows
  • Deeply data fluent and strong experimentation instinct: you obsesses about data, you define what good looks like before you build, and you are rigorous about measuring it
  • A first-principles thinker about complex service design. You are quick to build prototypes, sketch flows, write copies, and analyze and cut data to make your vision concrete
  • Able to work across clinical and technical teams, earn credibility with both, and translate between them clearly
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical tools, or other high-stakes domains is a strong plus

What We Value

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we understand the value of developing a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We prioritize diversity within our team, and we welcome candidates from all gender identities, castes, religious practices, sexual orientations, and abilities — among many others.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Sr.Product Manager - Tech
descriptionHtml:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth and carry products that our customers want and enjoy, while ensuring that customers are safe and get safe products from Amazon. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic and driven people. If you'd like to help us build an environment where our customer's safety is paramount, where we enable our customers to find and buy anything online, and where we ensure that we maintain and enhance customer trust on Amazon, then this is your chance to be part of a challenging and strategic initiative.

We're looking for a strong Senior Product Manager - Technical to join our team in Bangalore, India. This role requires exceptional technical depth in Generative AI, as you'll partner with Applied Scientists and Engineering teams to build next-generation AI-powered compliance and safety solutions. You should have strong technical problem-solving skills, product management expertise in AI/ML domains, excellent communication skills, and deep understanding of how to evaluate, deploy, and scale LLM-based systems in production environments. You should also possess the ability to influence people across the organization from tech leadership to business managers by creating win-win solutions, and the desire to be an individual contributor driving Amazon's next generation of AI-powered safety technology.

This role will report into the global product team that enables Trustworthy shopping experience at Amazon and ensures Safety and Compliance across Amazon stores. A primary focus of this role is defining the product strategy and roadmap for GenAI applications that automate compliance workflows, enhance decision-making accuracy, and scale our safety operations globally. You will work closely with Applied Scientists to evaluate LLM capabilities, design human-in-the-loop (HITL) systems, and establish AI governance frameworks that ensure responsible deployment of AI models in high-stakes compliance scenarios.

This role is inherently cross-functional—the professional will work closely with various partner teams across Amazon including Applied Science, Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Safety and Compliance to bring AI-powered products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our existing tech products and features. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, technically sophisticated in AI/ML domains, and will have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines while managing complex stakeholder alignment.

You should be passionate about retail, supply chain, consumer business, and building meaningful AI-powered products that transform how Amazon ensures customer safety at scale. Prior experience working in product management for AI/ML products, managing GenAI roadmaps, and working in retail or supply chain environments is preferred.

Key job responsibilities

GenAI Product Strategy & Execution

Define and own the 3-5 year product vision and roadmap for GenAI-powered compliance automation, balancing innovation with operational excellence

Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to evaluate LLM capabilities for safety and compliance workflows, including accuracy, latency, cost, and safety guardrails

Design and launch human-in-the-loop (HITL) systems that combine AI automation with human judgment for high-stakes compliance decisions

Establish metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI model performance, including precision/recall, false positive rates, cost per decision, and operational impact

Assess emerging LLM technologies (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.) and recommend strategic investments for Amazon's compliance tech stack

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

Work with internal customers to understand their use cases, pain points, and requirements for AI-assisted compliance workflows

Collaborate with partner engineering teams to drive product roadmaps for compliance and safety, ensuring technical excellence and scalability

Challenge Science teams on model architecture decisions, technical trade-offs, and design choices to ensure optimal product outcomes

Address bottlenecks, provide customer input, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints

Understand and articulate the technical reasons behind product architecture decisions and recognize when technical design limits future innovation

Cross-Functional Program Management

Partner with multiple tech, product, and operations teams across multiple locations with varying priorities to ensure timely delivery of AI solutions

Clarify and drive project commitments as well as establish and maintain clear chains of accountability across Science, Engineering, and Operations

Drive adoption of GenAI solutions across global compliance operations through change management, training, and stakeholder engagement

Manage complex initiatives across numerous business models and create certainty out of ambiguity while maintaining firm grasp over operational, financial, and technical aspects

Data-Driven Decision Making

Query and analyze data to derive insightful findings that inform product strategy and prioritization

Define success metrics for AI model deployment including business impact, operational efficiency gains, and customer experience improvements

Conduct cost-benefit analyses for GenAI investments, including model training costs, inference costs, and operational savings

AI Governance & Responsible AI

Establish AI governance frameworks and responsible AI practices for compliance use cases

Design evaluation protocols for model safety, bias detection, and fairness in automated decision-making

Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure AI solutions meet regulatory requirements and ethical standards

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team in a Hybrid capacity, reporting to the Director, Product Management within the Product Management department. You will drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the Zscaler DSPM product line at the forefront of the world’s cloud security leader. By joining our team of innovation champions, you will deliver a growing portfolio of capabilities in threat prevention, visibility, and business enablement while shaping the future product roadmap.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead the vision and lifecycle for specific modules within the Zscaler DSPM suite, ensuring the roadmap is agile and aligned with Zscaler’s high-level business priorities and market trends
  • Translate complex market needs into detailed technical requirements, providing clear needs to Engg teams to build high-performance features meeting acceptance criteria
  • Partner with other teams to navigate the development lifecycle, removing roadblocks and adjusting requirements for timely delivery
  • Act as the subject matter expert by analyzing the competitive landscape, identifying growth opportunities, and neutralizing threats through informed, data-driven product pivots
  • Drive product adoption by collaborating with Marketing and Sales on GTM plans and engaging with customers for roadmap presentations, feedback loops, and high-level escalations


Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bridge the gap between technical and business audiences, communicating complex concepts to internal teams, executives, and customers
  • 3–5 years of dedicated experience in Enterprise Product Management, specifically within the Cybersecurity or Information Security domains
  • Proven experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and data classification products with understanding of legacy tools and modern AI-based classification methods
  • Deep knowledge of Cloud Security products (commercial and CSP-native) and unique security challenges inherent to cloud environments
  • Hands-on experience and technical working knowledge of at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)


What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Knowledge of Cloud Posture Security Management (CSPM), auto-remediation, activity analytics, cloud-native API’s, security frameworks and compliance standards
  • Technical degree or a background in hands-on engineering, providing the architectural depth needed to lead complex product modules
  • Prior success in roles such as Escalation Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Deployment Services


At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Benefits

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

  • Various health plans
  • Time off plans for vacation and sick time
  • Parental leave options
  • Retirement options
  • Education reimbursement
  • In-office perks, and more!


Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.

Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. See more information by clicking on the Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal link.

Pay Transparency

Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.

Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Manager – PM

Experience: 10+ years

Location: Bangalore (On-site)


Role Summary

You will be part of the Product Management team for the Lending portfolio, with a strong focus on Loan Management and Servicing platforms. This role involves working closely with the Product Director, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to design, build, and enhance scalable lending products used by banks and financial institutions globally.

Your primary responsibility will be to own and evolve product capabilities across the loan lifecycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, configurability, and superior customer experience. You will translate complex lending domain requirements into clear product roadmaps and deliverables.


What Will You Do?

  • Define and execute product vision and roadmap for loan management systems aligned with business and market needs.
  • Own key lending modules including loan servicing, interest & fee management, repayments, collections, restructuring, and closures.
  • Act as the domain expert for retail, corporate, and SME lending, covering the full loan lifecycle.
  • Prioritize requirements based on customer value, regulatory needs, and commercial impact.
  • Collaborate with engineering, QA, UX, sales, and implementation teams to deliver high-quality releases.
  • Engage with customers and partners to capture real-world lending use cases and support pre-sales discussions.
  • Create PRDs, user stories, and functional documentation in Agile environments (Jira, Confluence).
  • Track product performance post-release and drive continuous improvements.


Skills & Qualifications Required

  • 10+ years of product management experience in BFSI lending or loan management platforms.
  • Strong experience in B2B enterprise software products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology (B.Tech or equivalent).
  • Deep expertise in loan lifecycle management, including EMI/interest calculations, collections, delinquency, restructuring, and closures.
  • Exposure to retail, corporate, SME, or Islamic lending is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, databases, configurable platforms, and Agile tools (Jira, Confluence).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives with an ownership-driven mindset.

title: Senior Product Manager (RAN Intelligent Controller)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager

(Telecom RIC and rApp)


Why should you choose us?


Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https://symphony.rakuten.com

Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global.


To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.


Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!

About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to approximately 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.


About the Role: Looking for an experienced Product Owner/Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and delivery of RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) platform and rApp. You will own the product backlog , roadmap, define use cases , solution with cross product owner and work closely with engineering, pre-sales, and customer teams to deliver measurable outcomes for Tier-1 and Tier-2 operators globally.


Mandatory Skills:

  • Telecom, Observability, 4G/5G, RAN , Core,
  • Cloud Infra
  • 4 years in product management (Minimum)
  • ORAN / RAN
  • RIC / Rapps / xapps


Key Responsibilities :


Product Strategy & Vision

  • Own and communicate the product roadmap for RIC platform and rApp
  • Define quarterly and annual product goals aligned with operator needs and market trends ]
  • Conduct market analysis and competitive benchmarking across vendors


Backlog & Delivery

  • Own, prioritize, and groom the product backlog; translate operator requirements into detailed, sprint-ready user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Define and maintain requirement documentation, use case specifications, and technical annexes for customer requirements
  • Drive NPI (New Product Introduction) process end-to-end


Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work directly with telecom customers (MNOs/MVNOs) to gather requirements, run workshops, and validate solution designs
  • Support to Respond to RFPs/RFIs with technical solution proposals and use case documentation
  • Present product demos, quarterly reviews, and roadmap sessions to CTO/CIO-level stakeholders
  • Represent the product in partner and alliance discussions


Cross-functional Leadership

  • Act as the bridge between business stakeholders, customers, and engineering teams
  • Run sprint ceremonies — planning, review, retrospective — in an Agile/SAFe environment
  • Manage dependencies across platform teams (Fault Monitor , Performance Monitor, Configuration Manager, Network Topology ,Network Inventory )


Required Skills & Experience:


Domain Knowledge

  • 10+ years of experience in Telecom, Packet Core , Access , with at least 2 years in a Product Owner or Product Manager role
  • Domain Knowledge of Telecom , 4G/5G, RAN , Core, Cloud & Infra
  • Deep understanding of Telecom, ORAN , RIC , rApp , Fault Management, Performance Management (PM counters, KPIs), SLA monitoring
  • Hands-on knowledge of 5G RAN, Core, and Cloud-native network architectures
  • Familiarity with ORAN Standards , 3GPP standards. Knowledge of TMF API Standards Add on
  • Contribution to ORAN standard body Add on
  • Experience with operator environments — NOC, zero-touch operations, AIOps


Technical Proficiency

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments and cloud-native microservices architecture
  • Ability to read and contribute to HLD documents, API specs, and integration design docs
  • Familiar with Python , Go , C & any public Cloud


Product & Agile

  • Proven experience owning a product backlog in Jira and running Agile/SAFe delivery
  • Ability to write crisp user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specs
  • Experience with roadmap tools (ProductBoard, or similar)
  • Strong RFP/RFI response experience — technical writing and solution architecture narratives


Good to Have

  • Experience with AI/ML-based anomaly detection in network monitoring contexts
  • Knowledge of GC log analysis, crash dump management, or binary log processing
  • Prior experience with operator deployments across regions (APAC, Europe, North America)


Soft Skills

  • Strong executive communication — able to present confidently to C-level stakeholders
  • Ability to work across time zones with distributed engineering and customer teams
  • Data-driven decision making — comfortable with metrics, dashboards, and usage analytics
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; able to define structure in fast-moving product environments


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Telecommunications, or Engineering
  • 10+ years total experience; 3+ years as PO/PM on a telecom software product
  • Certifications preferred: CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, TM Forum Framework

This role is ideal for someone who has operated at the intersection of telecom network operations and cloud-native software delivery — someone who speaks both 'operator NOC' and 'Kubernetes microservices' fluently.


RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES:

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

  • Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.
  • Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
  • Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.
  • Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.
  • Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

title: Senior Product Manager, IN DEX
descriptionHtml:
Description

Amazon India is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive delivery experience innovations as the India leader. This is a high-impact role with full ownership of initiatives that directly shape customer delivery experience and Amazon India's delivery economics across millions of orders. You will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for India-specific delivery experience innovations and you will drive adoption of both developed and under-development products to extract maximum value, partnering closely with partners across supply chain, operations, categories and engineering.

We are looking for a strong PM who can dive deep into promise systems, delivery operations, and customer experience, write detailed PRFAQs/PRDs, and deliver features in complex, ambiguous environments. Proficiency with AI-powered tools for rapid experimentation is highly valued. The role offers significant visibility with IES DEX leadership and IN stores leadership.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct responsibility for driving product adoption and value extraction across operations, supply chain, categories, and technology teams
  • Opportunity to leverage AI tools to accelerate product development cycles and experimentation velocity
  • Opportunity to drive India-specific innovations in delivery communication and promise systems
  • Significant cross-functional impact requiring strong stakeholder engagement and change management
  • Direct influence on customer delivery experience for millions of Amazon India customers
  • High visibility with senior leadership across India business and WW DEX teams

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive adoption of developed and under-development products to extract maximum value through strategic stakeholder engagement across operations, supply chain, categories, WW teams, and technology
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate experimentation cycles including rapid PRFAQ writing, prototype development, data analysis, and hypothesis validation
  • Use AI-powered tools to quickly iterate product concepts, create mockups, analyze customer feedback, and generate insights from operational data
  • Build and execute adoption strategies including training, documentation, stakeholder alignment, and change management to ensure products deliver intended business impact
  • Drive India-specific innovations to improve delivery experience, checkout experience and pricing/promotions strategy for millions of India customers.
  • Build deep understanding of promise systems and enable optimal ship option configurations to maximize utilization of available network capacity and capabilities
  • Define and track key performance indicators including delivery reliability metrics, intercept rates, revenue recovery, customer satisfaction, and product adoption rates

About The Team

As part of Amazon's India Delivery Experience (IN DEX) team, we work on some of the most challenging customer experience problems in India's complex delivery landscape. We partner with operations teams, supply chain, technology, business teams, and WW DEX to build innovative solutions that drive real impact on delivery reliability and customer satisfaction. With a focus on India-specific innovations, we translate customer pain points into robust, scalable products that deliver tangible value to customers and the Amazon India business.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
  • Experience in using statistical analysis to identify issues or opportunities for improvement

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience leading and defining requirements and driving these across diverse organizations
  • Proficiency with AI tools for rapid experimentation including PRFAQ writing, prototyping, data analysis, and insight generation. Demonstrated ability to use AI-powered tools to accelerate product development cycles and increase experimentation velocity

descriptionHtml:
Role: Lead Specialist, Product Management



Location: Bangalore (On-site)



We are seeking a customer‑centric Product Manager to lead product management for Credly and its enterprise integration ecosystem within Pearson’s ELS portfolio. This role focuses on scaling and evolving Credly as a platform product , enabling seamless integrations with learning, talent, and assessment systems used by enterprise and institutional customers.



This is a highly cross‑functional product role, working at the intersection of platform capabilities, API‑driven integrations, and enterprise customer needs . You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, UX, commercial, and customer success teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable integrations that drive adoption and business value.



The role is ideal for a Product Manager who thrives in B2B / B2B2C environments , understands platform and integration products , and can translate complex technical capabilities into clear customer value propositions.



Key Responsibilities



  • Own the product vision and roadmap for Credly’s integrations and platform capabilities, aligned to ELS and broader Pearson strategy.


  • Define and prioritise APIs, partner integrations, and platform features that enable Credly to integrate seamlessly with LMS, HRIS, talent, and assessment ecosystems.


  • Partner with enterprise customers, internal stakeholders, and partners to understand integration requirements, workflows, and constraints.


  • Collaborate closely with engineering, platform architecture, and security teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and compliant integration solutions.


  • Work with UX and design to ensure simple, intuitive experiences for administrators, partners, and developers.


  • Lead and contribute to a cross‑functional delivery squad , ensuring product outcomes are delivered with quality and predictability.


  • Use data, customer insights, and adoption metrics to inform prioritisation and iteration .


  • Support go‑to‑market and commercial teams by providing product input for customer conversations, solution positioning, and sales enablement.


  • Communicate a clear and compelling product narrative that articulates Credly’s platform value, integration strategy, and enterprise impact.


Candidate Profile



Experience & Qualifications



  • 4+ years of product management experience , preferably working on platform, integration, or SaaS products .


  • Demonstrated experience working closely with engineering and technical teams , including API‑first or integration‑heavy products.


  • Experience managing complex stakeholder environments , including enterprise customers, partners, and internal teams.


  • Strong understanding of B2B or B2B2C product delivery models.


  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and make informed trade‑offs.


Skills & Strengths



  • Strong customer‑focused mindset , with the ability to translate enterprise needs into clear product outcomes.


  • Comfortable working on platform capabilities rather than purely end‑user features .


  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills , able to align technical and non‑technical audiences.


  • Analytical and data‑informed, with a focus on measurable impact and adoption.


  • Familiarity with learning, credentials, talent, or skills ecosystems is desirable but not required.


Why Join Us



  • Influence the evolution of Credly as a global digital credentials platform .


  • Work on products that sit at the heart of Pearson’s enterprise and partner ecosystem .


  • Collaborate with experienced teams across product, engineering, and commercial functions.


  • Make a tangible impact on how skills and credentials are recognised and shared globally.


Who we are:



At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.



Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.



If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Toast is building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: running the businesses they love. We've grown into a leading hospitality software company in the U.S., and are now entering our next phase of growth—one defined by scale, complexity, and a new class of enterprise customers.

Every restaurant is unique, and a restaurant's menu expresses its individual brand and product offerings. Inside a Toast restaurant, the definition of the menu becomes the common language between guests, servers, and the kitchen. In our digital ordering products, a great menu serves as both a billboard and a roadmap to an excellent dining experience. It is the central hub for restaurant configuration—it determines what guests can order, how the dishes are presented and priced in different contexts, where they are routed for fulfillment, how they are prepared, whether the ingredients are still available, and how they are classified for reporting.

A menu is always evolving: kitchens create new dishes, managers experiment with pricing and presentation, and staff optimize the menu for restaurant operations. As our customers grow—from single-location cafés to enterprise brands with thousands of locations—so does the complexity of managing these changes consistently, confidently, and at scale.

The Menus team is building for this future. We own the user experiences and APIs that all Toast customers use to manage their menus, the APIs consumed by first- and third-party integrations (like DoorDash and UberEats), and the underlying menu data models that support the full spectrum of restaurant verticals—from Pizzerias to Fine Dining to Retail. We are working to make menus truly enterprise-grade: allowing customers to efficiently audit and manage changes across thousands of locations, while innovating on conversational menu management experiences powered by the Toast IQ platform.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the customer-facing menu management experience. You'll work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to craft an experience that helps customers manage their menus with confidence—whether they're rolling out a seasonal menu, updating prices across hundreds of locations, or restructuring their menu to improve kitchen throughput. You'll collaborate closely with a partner menus team based in the US to ensure a coherent and unified product strategy across the menus domain.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Own and evolve the product strategy for Toast's menu management experience, with a focus on:
  • Designing workflows that help customers manage menu changes over time—pricing updates, seasonal rotations, item availability, and structural changes that improve kitchen speed and operational efficiency
  • Building experiences that work for the full spectrum of Toast customers: from owner-operators managing a single location to enterprise teams managing menus across thousands
  • Exploring and integrating automation and AI-assisted ('agentic') workflows into menu configuration and publishing experiences, in partnership with the Toast IQ platform
  • Ensuring coherence across the menus product surface area, in close collaboration with the US-based menus PM and leadership
  • Build and maintain a roadmap in alignment with business OKRs, customer needs, and technical feasibility
  • Drive feature development from ideation through launch—writing clear specs, collaborating with engineering and design, and measuring success
  • In partnership with engineering and design counterparts, contribute to a development team by providing clear direction, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, and accountability

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably with platform or POS products
  • Strong track record of delivering user-facing features in fast-paced environments
  • Analytical rigor—you use data to make decisions and validate assumptions
  • Empathy for restaurants and a passion for improving their day-to-day
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence without authority
  • Experience working cross-functionally and collaborating effectively across time zones

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse, and we embrace that diversity with authenticity, inclusivity, respect, and humility. By embedding these principles into our culture and design, we create equitable opportunities for all and raise the bar in delivering exceptional experiences.

We Thrive Together

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the restaurant community. To learn more about how we work globally and regionally, check out: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

title: Lead Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary:-

The Lead Product Owner drives complex product initiatives, mentors Product Owners and Analysts, and establishes delivery standards across functional domains.

The role is expected to lead adoption of AI-enabled delivery operating models and drive consistency, scalability, and quality across teams.

The Lead Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R&D, responsible for managing a team of Product Owners. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.

Pre-requisites

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
  • MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of relevant experience.
  • Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
  • Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
  • Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
  • Experience of having worked in at least two implementation projects.
  • Led end-to-end requirements across multiple domains and modules.

Key Responsibilities

 Functional Leadership Responsibilities

  • Drive large and complex product initiatives across insurance functions.
  • Lead solution alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, QA, and Delivery teams.
  • Define product execution standards and governance practices.
  • Drive backlog prioritization aligned to strategic objectives.
  • Mentor Product Owners and Analysts; conduct training sessions for team members.
  • Support customer escalations and strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure consistency across functional deliverables and delivery practices.
  • Conduct User Forums and stakeholder workshops.
  • Work as a senior representative to project teams as needed.
  • Analysis and solution design using AI-assisted tools and frameworks.

AI-Enabled Leadership Responsibilities

  • Define AI-enabled delivery standards and best practices.
  • Establish reusable AI-assisted delivery patterns and knowledge frameworks.
  • Drive AI-assisted requirement quality and traceability standards.
  • Guide teams on responsible AI adoption.
  • Define review and validation mechanisms for AI-generated artifacts.
  • Identify opportunities for delivery acceleration using AI-assisted workflows.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled operating models across teams.

Mandatory Skills

  • Deep insurance domain expertise; strong understanding of insurance processes and core insurance systems.
  • Strong product ownership and solution leadership experience.
  • Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Solution Design.
  • Ability to manage complex cross-functional requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Strong systems thinking and enterprise understanding.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and initiatives.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and prioritization capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
  • Excellent analytical skills and good design skills.
  • Advanced SQL and data modelling skills (mandatory).
  • Understanding of SDLC and Agile concepts (mandatory).
  • Very good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to document business requirements as user stories; break large epics into smaller features and stories and document them in SDS.
  • Ability to conduct demos and walkthroughs with POs and business users.
  • Techno-functional and business solutioning capability.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI-enabled delivery tools.
  • Strong understanding of AI-enabled delivery practices.
  • Experience with AI-enabled delivery platforms and workflows.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Experience in modernization or transformation programs.
  • Exposure to AI governance and AI operating models.
  • Experience building reusable delivery frameworks.
  • Experience in using AI agents to elicit requirements and generate documentation.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration-based workflows.
  • Exposure to digital transformation initiatives.

Key Characteristics

  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring capability.
  • High ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to drive organizational change.
  • Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.
  • Systems thinking and cross-domain understanding.

title: Senior Product Manager - Payments Platform / Payment Framework
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for defining, delivering, and scaling core payment‑processing capabilities across global card‑present and card‑not‑present channels.

This role owns end‑to‑end product management for a defined set of payment platform capabilities, ensuring consistency, scalability, and alignment across gateways, processors, schemes, and downstream services. The Senior Manager partners closely with engineering, architecture, operations, risk, compliance, finance, and commercial teams to deliver high‑quality payment capabilities aligned with platform standards and regulatory requirements.

As a senior individual contributor, this role plays a key part in quarterly planning, roadmap execution, and cross‑team alignment within the Payment Processing Product Management organization and the broader Visa Acceptance Platform.

Payments Domain Expertise

  • Strong working knowledge of payment acceptance, processing, and orchestration, including authorization, settlement, tokenization, network rules, and payment‑scheme behaviors
  • Experience working with acquiring, gateway processing, issuer behaviors, and optionality across payment rails (card, wallets, A2A, alternative payments)
  • Familiarity with fraud‑management concepts (e.g., 3DS, routing strategies) is highly desirable

Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution

  • Contribute to and execute product strategy for assigned payment platform capabilities, including capability design and scaling considerations
  • Identify customer and market needs across merchants, PSPs, acquirers, and alternative payment methods
  • Translate customer, partner, and regulatory inputs into a clear, actionable roadmap/epic/features for payment flows and platform enhancements

Product Definition & Delivery

  • Define detailed product requirements, epics, features, process flows, and business rules for complex payment capabilities
  • Own cross‑functional readiness for assigned capabilities, including operational procedures, risk/compliance alignment, partner onboarding, and performance metrics
  • Participate in agile ceremonies as needed to ensure shared understanding and delivery against product goals
  • Ensure end‑to‑end payment experiences are well‑defined, including retries, fallbacks, routing logic, error handling, and user experience considerations

Data‑Driven Decision Making

  • Partner with analytics and operations teams to define KPIs, dashboards, and monitoring tools that support prioritization and performance tracking
  • Analyze trends such as authorization declines, fraud rates, routing effectiveness, and cost‑to‑serve to inform product improvements
  • Commercialization & Go‑to‑Market
  • Support development of value propositions, pricing inputs, merchant‑facing narratives, and readiness materials
  • Collaborate with sales, program management, finance, legal, compliance, UX, and partners to support go‑to‑market execution
  • Participate in merchant and partner engagements by clearly articulating product capabilities, differentiation, and roadmap direction

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

  • 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 6 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
  • Minimum of 5 years of product management experience in payment processing domain and API‑based products.
  • Strong expertise in payments processing, including gateways, acquiring, scheme rules, lifecycle flows, and regulatory considerations
  • Experience defining API contracts, platform capabilities, and contributing to longer‑term product architecture decisions
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, with a bias toward scalable, reusable product solutions

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
