title: Senior Product Manager - Finance Tech
descriptionHtml:
Innovate in Bengaluru

This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience. 

About Lowe’s

Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com

Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India

About The Team

This role will be part of Lowe’s Technology organization powering the Finance Technology Modernization program for Lowe’s Finance & Accounting. The vision of Finance Technology Modernization program is to deliver modern applications and tools that enable Lowe’s Finance & Accounting organization to rapidly operationalize strategic enterprise initiatives, drive productivity through automation/AI, and deploy modernized foundational capabilities for transaction processing, internal control and compliance, and financial reporting.

Job Summary

executing direction from leadership, delivering results that align with strategic objectives, communicating critical information to other teams, managing vendor relationships, developing processes that align to organizational goals, specific technical skills required for managing a process.

The Sr Product Manager owns the vision and strategy, roadmap, and feature definition for large, cross- functional and/or highly complex products. Responsibilities include defining the roadmap as well as planning and managing products and product features through the product development process. This role manages the product backlogs for a product group while prioritizing work and making product-related decisions based on the needs and expectations of customers and stakeholders. The individual in this role identifies and manages projects with a high level of autonomy. He/she manages multiple product designs at any given time while partnering closely with the business to understand pain points and develop the go-to-market strategy.

Roles & Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities:

Defines multiple large, cross-functional and/or highly complex products and identifies gaps and customer needs by creating vision, strategy and requirements documents for product(s); utilizing available studies (market research, internal) and competitive analysis to identify customer needs; performing experiments to uncover additional customer value; and partnering with the business to define product roadmaps and to establish the product vision

Develops and manages the product roadmap, demonstrating expertise at the product group level, building partnerships with relevant stakeholder teams, and making trade-off decisions for multiple products in a product group

Leads the product planning process across a product group by overseeing the development of requirements documents (user stories with acceptance criteria, use cases) for products or product releases; working closely with UX to oversee the design of the user experience across the product group; monitoring release goals, prioritization, implementation, and iteration plans for a product group; and resolving problems that are escalated

Who We Are:

At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

As Product Owner, you will work with the Product Manager for Customer 360 (C360) and the development team to ensure C360 meets the needs of its users to ultimately better serve our customers.

What You Will Do:

  • The C360 Product Owner supports the C360 Product Manager by interfacing with the development team.
  • Responsibilities include:
  • Gathering or clarifying business requirements
  • Creation of user stories to effectively communicate business requirements into dev requirements
  • Assist in QA testing of new features and bug fixes
  • Support agile process: daily scrums, sprint plannings, retros and backlog refinement.

Expectations of the Role:

  • Success in this role will be measured through:
  • Clarity and quality of user stories
  • Ability to independently manage small features
  • Stakeholder feedback

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Business, Engineering, or related field
  • 5-8 years of experience in product management
  • Experience with agile methodology
  • Strong communication skills

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Experience in aerospace industry
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO)
  • Familiarity with SQL

This role requires flexibility to accommodate stakeholder interactions and support business needs.

Onsite: Hybrid

title: Sr. Technical Product Manager, CCS
descriptionHtml:
Summary

We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to join our world-class product team.  We own the cloud platform layer which supports the foundation of our leading P&C applications, and we define the key platform features that will drive performance, scalability, resiliency, and adoption. This role entails working with global teams spanning product management, P&C insurance domain experts, operations and engineering.

Job Description

  • Product Manager with a strong background in the AuthN/Z domain, including SAML, IAM, OIDC/OAuth 2.0, load balancing, cloud services, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong mentoring and coaching experience as a Product Manager.
  • Gain an in-depth understanding of Guidewire applications, the cloud ecosystem that enables them, the market, competition, and user requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Enablement teams to define and maximize the value of our solutions.
  • Develop smart solutions to complex problems while collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to discover and test solution, and then refine and prioritize them.
  • Build and communicate roadmaps and requirements with teams and the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Launch new products and features, test their performance and iterate quickly.
  • You will be the power user of the products you build.
  • At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

We're Looking For Someone Who

  • Has a strong understanding and experience with AWS services (preferably certified as AWS Cloud Practitioner)
  • Can define and articulate product roadmaps with solid use cases and associated ROI.
  • Will detail feature requirements/specifications with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Is able to establish a shared vision across the company by building consensus on priorities leading to product execution.
  • Will collaborate with engineering and operations teams, through the design, development, testing, release, and maintenance of the product to ensure its quality and successful delivery.
  • Can find and lead opportunities for revenue growth, customer adoption and improved customer satisfaction.
  • Is comfortable managing product backlogs because there should be a priority for getting things done.
  • Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

But It Would Be Great If The Candidate Has

  • been certified as an AWS Cloud Practitioner
  • an understanding of containerization and container orchestration (Docker & Kubernetes).
  • familiarity with AHA and JIRA
  • can travel 5-10% of the time as and when necessary

Role Specific

  • Customer Need: Comfortable communicating with internal and external customers, understanding their underserved needs and documenting use cases
  • Product Strategy: Ability to research & distill customer needs, market needs, analysts voice, SME point of view into actionable and pragmatic product strategy & requirements.
  • Collaboration: Has a multiplier mindset and demonstrates ability and importance to collaborate with cross functional teams.
  • Result Driven: Data driven product manager that stays ahead of market and customers
  • Communication: Articulate to internal & external stakeholder both the business value level impact to GW goals.
  • Motivation: Person should have deep love and appreciation for the job of a product manager.

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title - Team Manager (Product and engineering lead)

Job Responsibility:

Team & Capability Building

  • Build and lead a cross-functional team across software, electronics, and engineering domains
  • Recruit, mentor and develop talent to create a strong, long-term capability
  • Establish a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement

Product Ownership & Delivery Leadership

  • Act as Product Owner / Delivery Lead for selected initiatives
  • Understand requirements from global experts and convert them into actionable backlogs
  • Drive end-to-end delivery (scope, planning, execution, release coordination)
  • Ensure alignment with product roadmaps and business goals
  • Technical Leadership (Balanced, Not Hands-on Coding Role)
  • Provide sufficient technical depth to:
  • Challenge requirements and clarify ambiguities
  • Guide architecture and solution direction (with experts)
  • Ensure effective collaboration between software, hardware, and system teams

External Supplier & Hardware Coordination

      • Own coordination with external partners for:
      • PCB design
      • Hardware manufacturing
      • Repairs and lifecycle management
      • Ensure quality, timelines, and integration with software deliveries
Stakeholder Management

      • Act as the single point of ownership for delivery towards global stakeholders
      • Build strong collaboration with product experts and engineering teams in Europe
      • Provide clear communication on progress, risks, and dependencies
Operational Excellence

  • Drive predictability in delivery (timelines, quality, cost)
  • Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor contributions
  • Continuously improve ways of working (agile, DevOps, hardware-software integration)

Other Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Computer Science, Electronics, or related field)
  • 10+ years of experience in engineering and delivery roles
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional technical teams
  • Experience working with global stakeholders in product organizations
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and agile methodologies
  • Ability to work across both software and hardware-oriented environments.
  • Background in IoT / embedded / industrial systems / connected products
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and data-driven solutions
  • Experience working with external engineering suppliers or manufacturing partners
  • Understanding of industries like mining, construction, or heavy equipment

In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

title: Principal Product Manager, Security
descriptionHtml:
Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

What To Know

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.

Principal Product Manager, Security

The Opportunity

We have an outstanding career opportunity for Principal Product Manager, Security at Bangalore location. As a Principal Product Manager, Security you will lead product discovery. You will deeply understand customer problems regarding data risk and recovery. You will navigate the operational constraints of massive-scale cloud environments to define how we protect and classify data across S3, DynamoDB, and Apache Iceberg.

About The Team

Clumio by Commvault is a leader in cloud-native cyber resilience. The product is a purpose-built SaaS platform designed to solve the "data protection gap" in high-scale cloud environments. title: Senior Product Manager Tech, Cart Building and Consolidation
descriptionHtml:
Description

The Cart Building and Consolidation team owns products that help customers build and manage their shopping cart throughout their purchase journey across Amazon's Emerging Stores. The team is looking for a high impact Product Manager who can identify common themes across geographies and bring together a coherent plan across disparate customer needs

Key job responsibilities

  • The Product Manager will be responsible for building and delivering on a roadmap of initiatives cutting across countries.
  • The Product Manager will need to identify key themes, align on top priorities, work with Tech, individual country leaders and other global teams to deliver goals.

A day in the life

The Product Manager will

(i) work with country teams to understand customer requirements

(ii) identify key gaps in current cart building initiatives and means to fill those

(iii) align with country leadership on top priorities ,

(iv) develop a Cart Building short-term and long-term roadmap cutting across geographies

(v) work with Tech on delivering to the roadmap

(vi) own product performance metrics across these geographies

About The Team

As part of the Delivery Experience vertical, we help customers across multiple geographies build and manage their shopping cart. We help customers (i) easily identify relevant items that they can purchase together (ii) select relevant delivery options that improve convenience of delivery (iii) help customers be more eco-friendly in their purchases. We own (i) the Tech products which help customers with the above and (ii) overall tracking and reporting of relevant metrics

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Principal Product Manager - Foundations
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Principal Product Manager

Location: India, Hybrid

This is a hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Bengaluru, India office as needed. Candidates must be based in India.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Clari + Salesloft, our Principal Product Mgr will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing team in India. We are looking for experienced Principal Product Mgr who can help realize Clari + Salesloft vision with their passion and proven track record of excellence and innovation. We are looking for Product Managers who are passionate about their work and who thrive working on leading-edge cloud-based technologies to develop ground-breaking AI-driven enterprise-grade applications.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible to -

  • Own the foundational integrations that power the platform
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and translate them into compelling solutions
  • Identify new product opportunities and anticipate potential risks and blockers
  • Collaborate with leaders of other functions to refine product strategy and execute process improvements
  • Build alignment and drive decision-making across company-wide initiatives
  • Build impactful relationships and driving collaborative initiatives across functional teams, effectively influencing stakeholders at all levels
  • Contribute to technical trade-offs, design clean product interfaces and abstractions, and build systems to scale customer, competitor, and market understanding throughout the organization
  • Work closely with Engineering to drive an efficient R&D process, from leading scrums to coordinating product releases
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Go-to-Market teams to ensure that we maximize the product's impact on both customers and our business

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to work on an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Principal Product Mgr to join our dynamic Product Management team. This role will focus on the strategic development and enhancement of our Platform capabilities with the support of a local engineering team based in India. The ideal candidate will bring a blend of technical acumen, a deep understanding of product management principles, and a passion for delivering innovative solutions that drive customer value.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Principal Product Mgr is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Clari + Salesloft’ s goal is to build the world's first AI driven Predictive Revenue System.

A world-class product is key to Clari+ Salesloft's success, and Product Management is at the center of defining and delivering the market's leading Revenue Platform. This involves working with customers and our Design/Engineering teams to solve some of the most important and challenging problems in business and enterprise software. We expect and empower PM's to operate with a "general management" mindset – you own the impact of your product area, and get to collaborate with every function in the company to make it happen!

THE SKILL SET:

  • 12+ years of enterprise SaaS experience in a Product role
  • In-depth understanding of data integration and API complexities, data flow across diverse ecosystems, data connectors, and the modern data stack
  • Demonstrated expertise in platform development, with a portfolio of successful products
  • Experience working with enterprise customers with multiple stakeholders and complex requirements
  • History of bringing new products and features to market from end to end
  • Outstanding presentation skills with the ability to communicate business and technical topics and adjust to diverse audiences

At Clari + Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from an @clari.com or @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Clari + Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, India Ads
descriptionHtml:
Description

Advertising is a strategic bet for Amazon and is one of the fastest growing business units within Amazon India. Sponsored Ads is our flagship performance ads product and the backbone of our Advertising business. We are strengthening our offering by continuously building and enhancing product capability to improve shopper engagement and advertiser experience.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager (Tech) to own monetization charter and grow Ads business in India and Emerging Markets.

You will work with a dedicated engineering and ML team and will heavily collaborate with stakeholders across WW, India and emerging countries. You will manage the complete business of your product area including establishing key metrics, setting and meeting goals on business/product metrics, advertiser engagement, and retention. You will be driving key metrics pertaining to advertisers, shoppers and Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

  • Identify product opportunities for the advertisement business using data, customer engagement studies and anecdotes. Create detailed near-term and longer-term roadmap for product.
  • Build product capabilities that help improve both advertiser experience (e.g. impressions, sales, ease of ad campaign management) and shopper engagement (e.g. CTR, relevance).
  • Build ads supply, formats, sourcing and ads relevance enhancements.
  • Use ML-techniques to build innovative solutions.
  • Play a key role in go-to-market of product features by influencing Marketing narrative and Sales / Account Management processes.
  • Manage all aspects of project including organizing and planning, estimating, managing resources, tracking, risk & opportunity, quality, documentation and change management.
  • Work closely with Tech and ML teams to create execution plans and ensure timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
  • Engage frequently with stakeholders (WW, India and Emerging markets) to identify collaboration opportunities

About The Team

You will be part of the IN Ads product team, reporting to the IN Ads product leader. You will have a dedicated Tech team (SDEs, TPM and SDM) for your Ad product and shared ML resources to help you innovate.

You will engage with other key teams in India Ads like Demand, Marketing, Sales and Account Management teams. Beyond these, you will have ample opportunities to interact and influence WW Product, Tech, Applied Science teams etc.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
  • Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
  • Experience Experience in online advertising or high-tech products/services

descriptionHtml:
At PwC, our people in finance focus on providing financial advice and strategic guidance to clients, helping them optimise their financial performance and make informed business decisions. These individuals handle financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and risk management.

In financial operations at PwC, you will focus on managing financial processes and confirming compliance with regulations. You will handle tasks such as financial reporting, budgeting, and risk management.

The Opportunity

  • When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, you’ll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
  • As part of the Internal Firm Services team you will support product vision, strategy, and backlog management for the SAP S4HANA System and finance systems. title: Senior Product Manager I
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Product Manager at SIXT, you will be creating solutions used globally by millions of users, revolutionising the way people experience mobility. In this position, you will play a critical role in developing the future of our digital products and enhance the customer experience for the entire rental experience. Together with various stakeholders, you'll be driving product initiatives that deliver value to our customers and create business impact at the moment of truth. If you want to be part of our journey and make an impact. Apply now!



YOUR ROLE AT SIXT

  • Lead a customer centric product strategy, roadmap and backlog, ensuring an intuitive and premium car rental experience across all digital touch points
  • Own and drive key features/projects over the full product development cycle: from ideation phase, through design, specification and development and over to the launch and post release analysis
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, UX, Analytics, data science, operations, and the business stakeholders to define, build and launch products/features
  • Demonstrate the ability to write crystal clear product specs, optimize conversion funnels, and to foster a culture of experimentation, encouraging the testing of new ideas and features through rapid prototyping and A/B testing
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, KPIs and results to all stakeholders, including senior leadership, ensuring alignment and buy-in across the organisation
  • Find the most efficient trade-off between high-value solutions for users and the complexity of implementation




YOUR SKILLS MATTER

  • You must have Bachelor's Engineering AND/OR Master's degree in business
  • You bring 5-8 years of product management experience, with strong technical depth and focus on customer-facing digital products
  • Experience with Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, APIs) while being updated on AI trends (LLMs, NLP, CV, GenAI) and identify opportunities for innovation
  • You MUST have experience working on Mobile-app development. Experience in B2C digital products or the travel/mobility industry is a plus
  • You're comfortable leading, using available data insights to help your team and peers to make strategic product decisions
  • You excel at analysing and communicating complex topics clearly and concisely across all organisational levels




WHAT WE OFFER

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: You Will be part of a dynamic tech-driven environment where innovation meets impact! We offer exciting challenges, cutting-edge technologies, and the opportunity to work with brilliant minds
  • Competitive Compensation: A market-leading salary with performance-based rewards
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance, wellness programs, and generous leave policies
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Our culture fosters continuous learning, collaboration, and flexibility, ensuring you grow while making a real difference. Hybrid Work policies




About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.00 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 350,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 110 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

title: Sr. Product Manager, Progression Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Description

As a Senior Product Manager on the Lifecycle Experiences team, you will own the product vision and execution roadmap for our Progression Intelligence charter. This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.

You will lead the technical integration of our rewards optimization, causal measurement, and action intelligence systems onto a unified agentic orchestration platform - enabling faster experimentation, more personalized interventions, and greater operational efficiency across all our emerging locales.

This is a deeply technical role that requires equal comfort with ML systems, API architecture, and product strategy. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and marketing stakeholders to ship systems that directly delight millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the multi-year product roadmap for Progression Intelligence, including the phased migration of core ML models and decisioning systems onto a unified orchestration platform
  • Define technical requirements and integration specifications for connecting rewards optimization, propensity modeling, causal incrementality measurement, and promotion configuration systems into a cohesive, real-time decisioning layer
  • Partner with applied scientists to translate model outputs into actionable product features - including reward denomination optimization, next-best-action recommendations, and personalized campaign triggers
  • Drive quarterly planning and prioritization across a portfolio of integrations, balancing technical debt, engineering capacity, and business impact
  • Define and own success metrics for the Progression Intelligence platform - including model coverage, decisioning latency, incremental lift, and customer settlement outcomes
  • Write product requirement documents and participate in technical design reviews, and lead alignment across engineering, science, and business stakeholders
  • Represent the Progression Intelligence charter in senior leadership reviews, including weekly business reviews and annual planning cycles
  • Identify and resolve technical dependencies and cross-team blockers to keep the integration roadmap on track

About The Team

The Lifecycle Experiences team is on a mission to deepen customer engagement across Amazon's fastest-growing marketplaces. We own the end-to-end customer lifecycle - from first purchase to habitual shopping - across India, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. Our north star is moving customers from occasional buyers to loyal, high-frequency shoppers.

We build and scale programs including Gamified Experiences, Rewards, Promotions Orchestration, and Personalization - reaching millions of customers across our fast growing marketplaces. We operate at the intersection of product, marketing, and data science, and we move fast.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience owning technology products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
  • Master's degree or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Product Manager – ZTNA or VPN experience is required
descriptionHtml:
SonicWall is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

About Cloud Secure Edge

Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall’s cloud-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform, providing enterprise-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN-as-a-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall’s SASE transformation.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp commercial instinct, influencing the platform’s evolution to deliver measurable security outcomes for SonicWall customers and partners.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy & Roadmap
  • Influence and help define the Cloud Secure Edge product vision and strategy; own the execution of the multi-quarter roadmap aligned with SonicWall’s SASE and Zero Trust go-to-market objectives.
  • Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and engineering feasibility.
  • Develop and present business cases for new investments to executive leadership, including TAM analysis, win/loss data, and projected impact on ARR.
Technical Product Ownership
  • Partner closely with engineering leadership to define requirements, write detailed specifications, and make informed trade-off decisions on scope, architecture, and delivery timelines.
  • Drive integration strategy across SonicWall’s security portfolio, including firewalls, endpoint agents, and threat intelligence services.
  • Ensure extensibility for MSP automation workflows and third-party integrations (SIEM, SOAR, IdP).
  • Evaluate and influence platform architecture decisions related to multi-tenancy, scalability, and cloud-native deployment models.
Zero Trust & SASE Domain Leadership
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on ZTNA, SSE, and SASE frameworks, educating cross-functional teams and informing competitive positioning.
  • Monitor and analyze the competitive landscape (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Cloudflare, Netskope) to identify differentiation opportunities and parity gaps.
  • Translate regulatory and compliance trends (NIST Zero Trust Architecture, CISA guidelines) into actionable product requirements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Go-to-Market
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop positioning, messaging, competitive battle cards, and sales enablement content.
  • Work directly with strategic customers and MSP partners to validate product direction, conduct design-partner programs, and gather feedback.
  • Support sales engineering teams with technical deep-dives, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Define and track product success metrics including adoption, activation, retention, NPS, and ARR contribution.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.
  • Deep working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, and/or VPN technologies and their underlying architectures.
  • Proven track record of shipping cloud-native or SaaS products at scale, with experience managing multi-tenant platforms.
  • Strong technical fluency: ability to engage with engineering teams on API design, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience working with channel and MSP partner ecosystems in the cybersecurity space.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to C-level stakeholders..
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience at a cybersecurity vendor in the SASE or SSE market (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Netskope, Fortinet).
  • Familiarity with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and their integration patterns with ZTNA platforms.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or relevant cloud/security credentials.
  • Experience with agile product development methodologies and tools (Jira, Aha!, Productboard).
  • Background in data-driven product management with proficiency in analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo).
  • AI fluency and demonstrated ability to prototype with AI tools: comfortable leveraging LLMs, copilots, and generative AI to accelerate research, ideation, spec writing, and rapid prototyping of product concepts.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

#ZTNA

#SASE

#SSE

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.  

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries.

title: Senior Digital Product Owner - Integration Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Career Area

Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Overview

Cat Digital is seeking a Senior Product Owner to lead the strategy and delivery of an enterprise integration platform that connects dealer systems, ERP platforms, and digital products across Caterpillar’s global ecosystem.

This role owns the product vision, roadmap, and execution for a high‑scale integration service that enables APIs, event‑driven integrations, and data sharing at enterprise scale. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable integration capabilities.

What You Will Do

Own the Product Vision

  • Define and execute the roadmap for an enterprise‑grade integration platform.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product outcomes.
  • Balance platform scalability, reliability, and speed of delivery.

Drive Delivery Excellence

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog across multiple integration initiatives.
  • Define clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
  • Partner with engineering to ensure quality, reliability, and operational readiness.

Lead Through Influence

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including product, engineering, data, and IT.
  • Act as the voice of the customer and platform users.
  • Influence architectural and delivery decisions without direct authority.

Enable Platform Governance

  • Drive consistent integration standards and patterns.
  • Reduce technical fragmentation and promote reuse.
  • Ensure security, reliability, and performance expectations are met.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Ownership or Product Management.
  • Strong experience with platform products, integrations, APIs, or distributed systems.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering and architecture teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise platforms, ERP ecosystems, or large‑scale integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud‑based integration architectures.
  • Experience in industrial, manufacturing, or dealer‑centric environments.

Why Join Cat Digital

  • Build platforms that power global dealer and enterprise ecosystems.
  • Work at the intersection of product strategy and deep technical platforms.
  • Influence how large‑scale digital integrations are designed and delivered.

Posting Dates

June 15, 2026 - June 28, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Senior PLM CoE Capability/Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

HP is seeking a Senior PLM COE Product Owner to join the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Center of Excellence within Supply Chain Transformation. This role owns and evolves enterprise PLM capabilities that directly enable supply chain performance, scalability, compliance, and risk reduction across HP’s global product portfolio.

The role independently drives complex, cross‑functional initiatives within SAP S/4HANA (MS4), partnering across business, IT, and enterprise architecture to deliver business‑relevant, scalable solutions that support long‑term supply chain strategy and operational execution.

This is a senior individual contributor position for a leader who operates with a high level of autonomy, leads through influence, and provides clear recommendations, trade‑offs, and decisions across the full lifecycle—from strategic intake and prioritization through release, adoption, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own one or more enterprise PLM capabilities end to end, from strategic intake and prioritization through delivery, release, adoption, and continuous optimization, ensuring solutions support supply chain effectiveness, product readiness, and business continuity
  • Serve as the business owner and solution authority for assigned PLM domains, with accountability for direction, decisions, outcomes, and measurable business value
  • Translate supply chain, engineering, and business priorities into actionable solution direction, aligning enterprise architecture, governance requirements, and PLM COE strategy
  • Lead requirement shaping, user story clarification, and acceptance criteria definition, ensuring scope clarity, data integrity, and optimized supply chain outcomes, with business benefits clearly documented
  • Develop and drive key design decisions and trade‑off recommendations, securing approvals through governance forums including Product Data Governance and the Architecture Review Board (ARB)
  • Ensure funding readiness, prioritization alignment, and organizational preparedness prior to release commitment
  • Own delivery outcomes in partnership with PLM IT through a 2‑in‑a‑Box model, proactively identifying risks, managing dependencies, and driving resolution with a clear, fact‑based point of view
  • Define and execute UAT strategy and sign‑off, ensuring SOX compliance, audit readiness, and controlled risk mitigation for production releases
  • Lead release readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and post‑release continuous improvement, ensuring adoption and sustained supply chain and operational impact
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, clearly communicating scope, progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations, and representing the domain with credibility across regions and functions
  • Drive cross‑functional decisions to closure in ambiguous or rapidly changing environments, maintaining momentum while balancing business risk, value, and technical constraints

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent experience
  • Extensive experience in PLM, ERP, and supply‑chain‑integrated systems, preferably in complex, global enterprise environments
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA preferred, or comparable enterprise platforms
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic initiatives in matrixed organizations
  • Familiarity with Agile or user‑story‑based delivery models

Knowledge and Skills

  • Deep knowledge of PLM concepts, including BOM structures, product master data, and lifecycle governance
  • Strong understanding of how product data, PLM governance, and system decisions impact supply chain performance and business risk
  • Experience operating in compliance‑driven and audit‑controlled environments
  • Familiarity with system integrations, data flows, and cross‑platform dependencies
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills
  • Ability to synthesize complex data and ambiguity into clear recommendations and executive‑ready guidance

Leadership Skills and Behaviors

  • Leads through influence across business, IT, and supply chain stakeholders
  • Operates independently on complex problems requiring in‑depth evaluation of multiple factors
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and follow‑through for strategic decisions and outcomes
  • Comfortable engaging with senior leaders, defending recommendations, and advising on trade‑offs, risks, and growth opportunities
  • Exhibits learning agility, digital fluency, and a continuous improvement mindset aligned with HP values

Impact & Scope

  • Impacts enterprise supply chain and product lifecycle capabilities, providing expertise and leadership across functional and cross‑functional initiatives
  • Contributes to the development of competitive, scalable supply chain solutions through standardized PLM capabilities

Disclaimer

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

title: Technical Product Manager, Release Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Summary

Join Guidewire’s Product Development & Operations (PDO) team in Bengaluru, where we deliver operational excellence and transformative innovation for the world’s leading P&C insurance software. Our team is dedicated to building secure, scalable, and efficient cloud solutions that drive measurable value for customers, collaborating in a culture of curiosity, continuous improvement, and shared success. We focus on AI, cloud, and data platform adoption to ensure every customer is successful and referenceable.

As a Senior Product Manager, Release Engineering, you will drive the strategy and execution of Guidewire’s Release Engineering capabilities, enabling seamless delivery and adoption of our cloud products. This is a high-impact role for a results-oriented leader who thrives on solving complex problems and shaping the future of cloud-based insurance technology. Your expertise will help Guidewire accelerate innovation, optimize cloud operations, and empower customers to achieve business agility.

Job Description

What you’ll do

  • Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and vision for Release Engineering, ensuring alignment with Guidewire’s cloud and AI transformation priorities.
  • Establish and optimize the path to production for all Guidewire applications and services, focusing on secure, scalable, and efficient delivery.
  • Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to release velocity, quality, and end-user satisfaction.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to evolve Guidewire’s agile development lifecycle, accelerating the delivery of capabilities for cloud hosting.
  • Deliver robust test environments that empower the Guidewire community to build, test, and validate solutions with confidence.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed automation, DevOps, and best practices into release processes.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, innovative environment, championing continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

Required

What you’ll bring

  • Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  • 8+ years of experience in the commercial enterprise/B2B software market, with at least 5+ years in technical product management.
  • Proven experience in release engineering, DevOps, and software automation for large, complex applications.
  • Deep understanding of source code management, compilers, build configuration languages, automated build tools, package managers, and installers.
  • Experience with sandbox environments, especially in cloud-based platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), services, and APIs.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and analytical skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams and with senior executives.
  • Keen judgment in analyzing sophisticated problems, making prioritization decisions, and providing clear direction to product teams.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience in the P&C insurance or SaaS industry.
  • Familiarity with security, compliance, and operational excellence in cloud environments.

Your Impact

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you’ll partner with engineering and product teams to define and launch new release engineering processes, deliver measurable improvements in release velocity and quality, and help drive the adoption of cloud-native practices. Your work will directly support Guidewire’s mission to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions for our customers, contributing to operational excellence and transformative innovation. Over time, your leadership will influence how Guidewire delivers value to customers and shapes the future of insurance technology.

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

title: Senior Staff Technical Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

We are building a secure, compliant, and highly reliable healthcare data platform that transports and transforms clinical and operational data from hospital on‑premises environments to the cloud. As a Sr. Staff Technical Product Owner, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes for end‑to‑end data movement, interoperability, and governance—working across global product managers in multiple healthcare sub‑segments to deliver interoperable, scalable, and cost‑efficient data capabilities.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Own vision & roadmap
    • Translate organizational strategy into a platform‑level multi‑release roadmap with clear value milestones and measurable outcomes.
    • Continuously capture Voice of Customer (VoC) from catching programs and adjust prioritization and scope to maximize impact.
  • Backlog leadership
    • Author and maintain Epics, Features, and User Stories with acceptance criteria; ensure traceability to business outcomes and regulatory/compliance needs.
    • Lead backlog grooming, PI planning, and cross‑program dependency management (SAFe or equivalent).
  • Bridge product & engineering
    • Act as the primary interface between global product managers and engineering leads, ensuring scope clarity, non‑functional requirements (performance, reliability, security), and delivery quality.
    • Drive design‑to‑value decisions across ingestion, streaming, API exposure, and data storage layers in future.
  • Healthcare interoperability & data standards
    • Define patterns for HL7 v2.x, FHIR - Mapping/translation
    • Guide implementation choices for integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody) and schema governance.
  • Secure & compliant data movement (on‑prem → cloud)
    • Own product requirements for connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, Site‑to‑Site VPN, SD‑WAN, private links), data in motion (TLS 1.2/1.3, mTLS, certificate rotation), and data at rest (KMS/HSM encryption, key rotation).
    • Define AuthN/AuthZ strategies (OIDC/OAuth2, SAML, RBAC/ABAC, least privilege) and secrets management.
    • Ensure adherence to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regional privacy laws (e.g., GDPR).
  • Streaming & data platform architecture
    • Shape the streaming roadmap using Kafka (brokers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, schema registry, Avro/Protobuf), Kafka Connect, and CDC pipelines or any similar technology
    • Partner with architects on scalable ingestion, schema evolution, replay, dead‑letter handling, and observability (OpenTelemetry, metrics, tracing, logs).
  • AWS platform delivery
    • Define requirements and guardrails for AWS services such as S3, MSK (or self‑managed Kafka), Glue, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, PrivateLink, CloudWatch, KMS, Secrets Manager.
    • Drive reliability goals (SLOs/SLAs, RTO/RPO), disaster recovery patterns, and multi‑account/multi‑region design as needed.
  • Cloud cost optimization (FinOps)
    • Lead cost‑to‑serve modeling and reduction initiatives: right‑sizing, instance families compression/partitioning, autoscaling, and data egress minimization.
    • Establish cost dashboards, budgets, and per‑feature cost accountability.
  • Cybersecurity & privacy
    • Stay current with cybersecurity best practices (zero‑trust, network segmentation, vulnerability management, threat modelling, security testing, SBOM where applicable).
    • Champion privacy‑by‑design, data minimization, de‑identification/pseudonymization where appropriate.
What You’ll Bring (Required Qualifications)

  • Experience: 12–15+ years in product management/ownership or platform leadership, with 5+ years focused on data platforms/streaming and 3+ years in healthcare data interoperability.
  • Deep technical fluency in:
    • Streaming with Kafka (clusters, partitioning strategy, throughput/latency tuning, schema registry).
    • Data security: encryption at rest/in transit, AuthN/AuthZ (OIDC/OAuth2/SAML), RBAC/ABAC, secrets management.
    • AWS core data & networking services; secure connectivity from on‑prem to cloud (Direct Connect, VPN, private connectivity).
    • Cybersecurity controls and compliance frameworks relevant to healthcare (HIPAA/HITRUST/SOC 2).
  • Healthcare standards: hands‑on with HL7 v2, FHIR
  • Roadmap & execution: proven track record translating vision into incremental deliveries; ownership of Epics/Features/Stories and measurable outcomes.
  • Cross‑functional leadership: success aligning multiple global product managers and engineering teams in a highly dynamic environment.
  • Cloud cost reduction: demonstrable wins lowering run‑rate and egress costs, optimizing storage/compute, and implementing FinOps practices.
  • Communication: excellent written/verbal skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and vice‑versa.
  • Hands on experience in Product Management using Gen AI tooling
Nice To Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody), and EMR/vendor ecosystems (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, Meditech, etc.).
  • Knowledge of data governance & cataloguing (e.g., AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog), lineage, DQ frameworks, and PHI/PII handling patterns.
  • Familiarity with event‑driven and API‑first architectures (REST/gRPC), Idempotency, Exactly‑once/At‑least‑once semantics.
  • Observability tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk,Promethesu, Graffana) and SRE practices (error budgets, SLOs).

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

- Cross‑functional leadership: success aligning multiple global product managers and engineering teams in a highly dynamic environment.
- Cloud cost reduction: demonstrable wins lowering run‑rate and egress costs, optimizing storage/compute, and implementing FinOps practices.
- Communication: excellent written/verbal skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and vice‑versa.
- Hands on experience in Product Management using Gen AI tooling
Nice To Have (Preferred Qualifications)



- Experience with integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody), and EMR/vendor ecosystems (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, Meditech, etc.).
- Knowledge of data governance & cataloguing (e.g., AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog), lineage, DQ frameworks, and PHI/PII handling patterns.
- Familiarity with event‑driven and API‑first architectures (REST/gRPC), Idempotency, Exactly‑once/At‑least‑once semantics.
- Observability tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk,Promethesu, Graffana) and SRE practices (error budgets, SLOs).

Job Overview

A Hospital Information System (HIS) Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and managing the product backlog for assigned modules within the HIS, ensuring the product meets business needs and delivers value to users.   • Stakeholder Management
  • Collaborating with various stakeholders, including clinicians, administrators, and IT teams, to gather feedback, manage expectations, and ensure alignment
  • Agile Development
  • Participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and other Agile ceremonies to guide development efforts and ensure timely delivery.

At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Customer Service Digital Products team is seeking a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Product Owner to support the execution and day-to-day management of the Dynamics 365 CRM platform.

CRM is the central platform used to manage customer, account, and stakeholder information across the organization. It supports end-to-end business processes by improving data visibility, streamlining workflows, enabling reporting, and helping teams make informed decisions through accurate, centralized customer information.

  • Consistent and predictable sprint delivery outcomes
  • Timely resolution and escalation of complex issues

title: ServiceNow Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As the ServiceNow Product Owner, you will be accountable for defining and executing the product vision, roadmap, and governance of the ServiceNow platform across the enterprise. You will act as the owner for platform strategy, ensuring that ServiceNow delivers measurable business value, supports standardized ITSM processes, and enables future-ready capabilities such as CSDM adoption and AI-driven automation.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, architecture teams, and delivery organizations to prioritize demand, rationalize customizations, and drive the platform towards out-of-the-box (OOTB) best practices. This role is critical in ensuring platform scalability, data integrity (CMDB), and seamless integration across the IT ecosystem.

Operating in a global and cross-functional environment, you will balance strategic vision with execution discipline—enabling innovation while ensuring governance, stability, and operational excellence.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Define and own the ServiceNow product strategy, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with enterprise digital and IT priorities
  • Drive demand prioritization and backlog management, optimizing delivery based on business value, risk, and strategic objectives
  • Champion adoption of out-of-the-box (OOTB) capabilities, reducing customization and minimizing technical debt
  • Establish and enforce platform governance, design standards, and architectural guardrails
  • Lead platform rationalization and standardization across ITSM, ITOM, and related service domains
  • Oversee end-to-end delivery of ServiceNow enhancements, releases, and platform capabilities
  • Act as the primary interface between business, IT, and delivery teams, ensuring alignment and execution clarity
  • Engage senior stakeholders to align priorities, drive decision-making, and articulate platform value
  • Drive continuous improvement using feedback, analytics, and usage insights
  • Enable effective cross-functional collaboration across internal teams, ecosystem partners, and vendors
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI-driven use cases, and intelligent workflows on the platform
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging capabilities (e.g., ITOM, AIOps, workflow automation) to enhance platform value
  • Support and enable enterprise-wide transformation initiatives leveraging the ServiceNow platform

Key Skills And Experience

You have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • 15+ years of experience in IT / Telecom, with significant exposure to ServiceNow platform
  • Proven experience as a ServiceNow Product Owner / Platform Owner / Lead Architect in large enterprises
  • Strong understanding of ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, and CSDM frameworks
  • Experience in platform governance, roadmap planning, and demand prioritization
  • Proficiency in ServiceNow configuration, scripting, and integrations
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional, global teams and stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

Preferred:

  • Experience in driving platform standardization and OOTB transformation programs
  • Exposure to AI, automation, and digital workflow enablement within ServiceNow
  • Experience with Performance Analytics, Reporting, and value tracking frameworks
  • ServiceNow certifications
  • ITIL v4 certification

If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
